items.titleZh: 小红牛延长拉森F1合同至2027赛季，打破马克奥时代
items.summaryZh: 小红牛延长了利亚姆·拉森的F1合同至2027赛季，避免了前所未有的车手解雇。拉森的席位近期面临巨大风险，因为F2赛事冠军尼古拉·索洛夫在等待机会，而小红牛需要决定哪两位车手将在下赛季为车队出战。
items.originalTitle: Red Bull's Lawson decision is a clean break from its Marko era
detailZh: 小红牛延长了利亚姆·拉森的F1合同至2027赛季 - 拉森可以感谢他最近的表现，这说服了小红牛避免前所未有的车手解雇。
拉森在小红牛第二车队的席位在最近几轮比赛中面临真实的风险，因为F2赛事冠军尼古拉·索洛夫在等待机会，而小红牛需要决定哪两位车手将在下赛季为车队出战。
但如果拉森失去了席位——在其他车队没有2027赛季的赛车席位——这将是一项史无前例的举动。
在过去10个赛季的F1中，只有两位车手的表现与拉森目前的表现相当，被解雇后却没有下赛季的替代席位。
只有塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯——他在2024年锦标赛中排名第八——和亚历克斯·阿隆索——他在2020年锦标赛中排名第七——在现在的拉森（第九名）之前排名更高，但第二年却发现自己没有车可开。
当然，他们都因为红牛车队而遭遇了这样的命运，但最大的不同是佩雷斯和阿隆索都是为红牛车队驾驶，并在过程中被马克斯·维斯塔潘彻底击败。
拉森的情况完全不同，他是2026年世界锦标赛所有中游车手中排名最高的，并且轻松领先他的新秀队友林德布拉德。
对拉森位置的威胁主要来自F2冠军候选人Tsolov。这位保加利亚人在他的新秀F2赛季中赢得了六场比赛，仅落后于2027年哈斯F1车手和法拉利青训车队成员拉斐尔·卡马拉——他在巴西取代埃斯特班·奥康首次亮相F1。
Tsolov凭借其在F2赛事中的出色表现，以及他在墨西哥强制性的新人FP1练习中替代劳森时所展现出的出色表现，已经为晋升做出了强有力的证明。这不仅是因为他在F2赛事中的成绩，还因为他在墨西哥替代劳森参加强制新人FP1练习时，表现出了对F1赛事的从容不迫。
在Tsolov在墨西哥的出色表现之上，劳森后来在FP2练习中与红牛车队的主将维斯塔潘发生了冲突——这使劳森遭到了四次世界冠军的严厉斥责，其中维斯塔潘暗示了劳森2027年合同的不确定性。
《赛车》杂志理解，最近的连续三场赛事基本上是红牛车队和小红牛进行最终分析的关键时刻，以确定下一年谁将驾驶赛车——因此，在这段时间内，劳森承受着压力，真的有失去座位的风险。
这也可能解释了维斯塔潘在墨西哥碰撞之后尖锐的评论：“当你处于他的位置上，选择与我发生冲突，这根本不是一种明智的行为。”
但是劳森从那个低谷中反弹回来，从资格赛的技战术排除和维修区发车到最终第七名完成比赛，他熟悉的领先中游位置展现出了真正的毅力。
再加上劳森在巴西的雨天表现——资格赛第五名和正赛第七名——在红牛体系中，任何人都很难提出他应该被肯定淘汰的理由。
只有劳森真正处于危险之中——因为林德布拉德作为新秀与他并肩作战，出色地完成了工作，贡献了35%的积分，这让小红牛几乎肯定能以第五名的成绩结束车队历史上最高的位置。
劳森在车队中的工作本质上是给红牛提供一个衡量林德布拉德表现的基准。劳森再次成为红牛赛车座位的竞争者几乎是不可能的，就像林德布拉德或最终茨洛夫可能还有机会一样。
问题是，劳森在本赛季他的角色中做得如此出色——甚至在他为红牛车队在三次比赛中替换伊萨克·哈迪亚尔之后，作为车手又迈出了进一步的一步——以至于即使他的存在不再真正符合小红牛应该拥有的'红牛输送带'功能，他也变得难以被淘汰。
在巴西的周五，小红牛车队老板艾伦·帕尔曼表示，小红牛正在尝试对这种情况“应用一点科学”，这是对过去赫尔穆特·马克奥似乎几乎随心所欲地雇佣和解雇青训车手的那些日子的明确反驳。
“红牛有一个非常成功的年轻车手项目，而且我不想批评它，但是我认为如果你们批评它，也许有时候车手们没有足够的时间来适应，或者也许有些仓促的决定已经被做出。”帕尔曼说。
劳森在排位赛中相对于林德布拉德的平均优势只有七百分之一秒，但在比赛中——那里才是积分被发放的地方——劳森有明显的优势。
他在今年为小红牛参加的17场大奖赛中，有13场得分，还在6场冲刺赛中获得了积分。在14场比赛中，他和林德布拉德都完成了比赛，他11次领先林德布拉德，在77%的比赛中领先他。
这使得他成为了中场的无可争议的王者。在今年举行的52场资格赛和比赛中，包括冲刺赛，劳森有18次被归类为该组的第一名。
为了将这个数字放在正确的背景下，请记住，阿尔卑斯和奥迪在该组的前端竞争中非常接近，而且劳森在其中的8场比赛中没有进入中场，因为他当时在哈吉尔的小红牛车队。
他的方法也引起了人们的注意。在2026年之前，他的战斗决策有时可能是自我毁灭的。这导致了比必要的更多赛道事故。
今年他在这方面做得很好，尽管仍然努力争取结果。
他也很好地适应了2026年的赛车，意识到他需要控制超车欲望，以充分利用它们 - 对于一个在弯道入口时可能天生具有侵略性的车手来说，这并不容易做到。
他还能连续很好地完成周末的比赛，即使周五开始得不好，也能扭转局势。在为红牛的三次出赛中，他也表现得很好，尽管2025年发生在他身上的事情留下了伤痕。这显示了他的心理韧性，这也反映在他对未来不确定的心态中。他能够专注于自己的工作，没有被这些事情分心 - 这比说起来容易做起来。
劳森解释说：“一年前我考虑了很多。这非常占据我的头脑，当你过度思考时，你的驾驶就会变差。”
劳森并没有突然将自己变成F1中最好的车手。但他已经迈出了成为全面、稳定和可靠的中间集团选手的一大步——而且速度也非常快。
这就是他最终成为2027年不可替代的原因。
在宣布最终结果之前，佩尔马内已经暗示“每个人都会很高兴”，这表明现在劳森已经确认，Tsolov将会有替代安排——这很可能是成为官方储备车手，并在2027年进行更多F1测试和自由练习。
detailEn: Racing Bulls has extended Liam Lawson’s Formula 1 contract into the 2027 season - and Lawson can thank his recent performances for convincing Red Bull to avoid an unprecedented driver sacking.

Lawson’s seat in Red Bull’s second team has been at very real risk in recent rounds, with Formula 2 race winner Nikola Tsolov waiting in the wings and Red Bull needing to decide which two of Lawson, Tsolov and Arvid Lindblad race for Racing Bulls next year.
But had Lawson lost out - with zero options elsewhere on the grid to race in 2027 - it would have been an unprecedented move.

In the past 10 seasons of F1, there have only been two comparable cases of a driver doing as well as Lawson is currently doing, getting dropped and then not having an alternative seat for the following season.

Only Sergio Perez - who was eighth in the 2024 championship - and Alex Albon - who was seventh in the 2020 championship - have been higher placed than Lawson is right now (ninth) and yet found themselves without a drive the year after.
Both, of course, met that fate thanks to Red Bull, but the big difference is both Perez and Albon were driving for Red Bull Racing - and getting absolutely destroyed by Max Verstappen in the process.
Lawson is in a completely different situation here, in that he’s the highest-placed of all midfield drivers in the 2026 world championship and comfortably ahead of his rookie team-mate Lindblad.

The main threat to Lawson’s position comes from F2 title contender Tsolov. The Bulgarian has won six races in his rookie F2 season and sits only seven points behind 2027 Haas F1 driver and Ferrari junior Rafael Camara - who made his F1 debut in place of Esteban Ocon in Brazil.

Tsolov has made a strong case for promotion, not only because of those F2 results but also because of how well he did subbing for Lawson in a mandated rookie FP1 outing in Mexico, where Tsolov lapped within two tenths of Lindblad and generally looked very at ease with the whole business of being in F1.

On top of Tsolov’s impressive showing in Mexico, Lawson later had a run-in with Red Bull’s kingpin driver Verstappen during FP2 - which earned Lawson a strong rebuke from the four-time champion, in which Verstappen alluded to Lawson’s 2027 deal uncertainty.

The Race understands the recent triple-header has basically been the crunch moment for Red Bull and Racing Bulls to do their final analysis on who should drive next year - so Lawson has been under pressure during this period and at genuine risk of losing his seat.
Which perhaps explains Verstappen’s pointed remark in the wake of their collision in Mexico, “It’s just not very smart behaviour when you’re in his position to pick a fight with me.”

But the way Lawson rebounded from that low point, recovering from a technical exclusion in qualifying and a pitlane start to finish seventh that weekend, in his familiar position as the leading midfield runner, showed true grit.

Add that to the way Lawson excelled in the wet in Brazil - fifth in qualifying and seventh in the race - and it’s difficult for anyone inside the Red Bull system to make the case he should definitely be dropped.

It has only been Lawson at real risk - because Lindblad has done an excellent job alongside him as a rookie and contributed a meaningful 35% of the points that leave Racing Bulls almost certain to finish fifth in the constructors’ championship - the highest place in the team’s history.

Lawson’s job within that team is essentially to give Red Bull a benchmark of performance to measure Lindblad against. There’s no realistic possibility of Lawson becoming a contender for a Red Bull Racing seat again, in the way there might still be for Lindblad or, eventually, Tsolov.

The trouble is that Lawson has done such an excellent job in his role this season - and has even taken a further step as a driver since subbing for Isack Hadjar at Red Bull for three races - that he made himself impossible to drop even though his presence no longer really fits the 'Red Bull conveyor belt' function Racing Bulls is supposed to have.

On Friday in Brazil, Racing Bulls team boss Alan Permane said Racing Bulls is trying to “apply a little bit of science” to the situation, a clear rebuke of the days when Helmut Marko would hire and fire junior drivers seemingly almost on a whim.

“Red Bull's had a very successful young driver programme, and if I want to be... and I don't want to be critical of it, but I think if you guys are critical of it, maybe sometimes the drivers haven't been able to have enough time to settle, or maybe some snap decisions have been made,” Permane said.
Lawson’s average qualifying advantage over Lindblad is only seven hundredths of a second, but in the races - where the points are paid out - Lawson has a clear advantage.

He’s scored in 13 of the 17 grands prix he’s started for Racing Bulls this year, as well as taking points in three of the six sprint races staged. He’s also finished ahead of Lindblad 11 times out of the 14 races they have both finished and run ahead of him on 77% of the racing laps both completed.
That’s made him the undisputed king of the midfield. Of the 52 qualifying sessions and races, including sprints, held this year, Lawson has been classified at the top of that group 18 times.

To put that number in context, remember Alpine and Audi have made the fight at the front of that group a close one, and that Lawson wasn’t part of the midfield for eight of those because he was in Hadjar’s Red Bull.
His approach has also caught the eye. Prior to 2026, there were times when his decision-making in battle could be self-defeating. That led to more on-track incidents than necessary.
That’s something he’s largely cut out this year, while still fighting hard enough to get the results.

He’s also adapted well to the 2026 cars, recognising he needed to contain the desire to over-drive to get the most out of them - not easy to do for a driver who can be naturally aggressive on corner entries.

He’s also able to piece together weekends consistently well, often turning things round even if they start badly on Friday.He also did a good job in those three outings for Red Bull, despite the scars of what happened to him in 2025. That shows a mental robustness, which is also reflected in his mindset amid uncertainty about his future. He’s been able to focus on doing his job and not been distracted by this - something that is easier said than done.
Lawson explained: “A year ago I thought about it a lot. It was very much in my head and you just drive worse when you overthink things.”
Lawson hasn’t suddenly transformed himself into the best driver in F1. But he’s taken a big step to become a rounded, consistent, and dependable midfield performer - and a very quick one too.
That’s what eventually made him undroppable for 2027.

Permane had already suggested “everyone will be happy” when the announcement finally came, so that suggests that now Lawson has been confirmed alternative arrangements will be made for Tsolov - which will most likely mean an official reserve driver role and an expanded programme of F1 testing and free practice running in 2027.

items.originalTitle: Racing Bulls officially keeps Lawson for 2027
items.summaryEn: Racing Bulls has announced an unchanged Formula 1 line-up for 2027, with Liam Lawson staying alongside Arvid Lindblad.
detailZh: 小红牛宣布2027赛季F1车手阵容不变，利亚姆·劳森下赛季将继续留在车队。
这位新西兰车手的未来此前数周一直不确定，这家红牛旗下的车队曾考虑是让他继续与阿尔维德·林德布拉德搭档，还是提拔青训车手尼古拉·措洛夫。
不过，正如本周早些时候所报道的，劳森近期在墨西哥和巴西的强劲表现被认为让他走上了获得新合同的道路，并让小红牛确信他是最佳人选。
劳森目前位居车手积分榜第九，是前四支车队之外的最佳车手，他的贡献对小红牛位居车队积分榜第五至关重要，放弃他本会是不合理的。
小红牛车队领队艾伦·珀曼认为，劳森和林德布拉德的阵容在融合年轻与经验方面堪称完美。
“两人在整个赛季中都展现了各自的能力和潜力，我们也看到了他们取得的进步，无论是个人还是作为搭档，”珀曼解释道。
“我毫不怀疑这是对我们而言最好的车手阵容，带来了经验与雄心的强强组合。我们将携手在今年的进展基础上夯实基础，继续推动自己前进，迈出下一步，朝着在2027年实现我们目标的方向努力。”
劳森今年在围场中因其在小红牛以及顶替受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔代表红牛出战时的出色表现而赢得赞誉。
他感谢了小红牛（小红牛）对他的信任。
“我们共同度过了一个出色的赛季，车队非常努力地打造了一辆快车，我很喜欢驾驶它，”他说。
“能成为车队历史性赛季的一部分感觉很棒，我们继续为制造商锦标赛第五名而战。
“这证明了赛道现场和工厂后方每个人付出的辛勤努力。我期待与阿维德一起将这股势头保持到2027年；我们正在建设非常积极的东西，我对我们能共同取得的成就感到兴奋。”
小红牛（小红牛）在宣布劳森和林德布拉德留队至2027年的声明中，并未提及对措洛夫的安排，而措洛夫今年正力争拿下F2年度冠军。
这位保加利亚车手在墨西哥为小红牛（小红牛）完成了一次新秀一练，2027年很可能在红牛承担更重要的角色。他也被传可能转战日本超级方程式。
小红牛（小红牛）：利亚姆·劳森/阿维德·林德布拉德
阿斯顿·马丁：费尔南多·阿隆索/兰斯·斯特罗尔
detailEn: Liam Lawson will remain at Racing Bulls next season after the squad announced an unchanged Formula 1 line-up for 2027.
The New Zealander’s future had been uncertain for many weeks, with the Red Bull-owned outfit pondering whether to keep him on alongside Arvid Lindblad or promote its junior driver Nikola Tsolov.

However, as reported earlier this week, Lawson’s recent strong performances in Mexico and Brazil were understood to have put him on course for a new deal and convinced Racing Bulls he was the best candidate.

With Lawson currently sitting ninth in the drivers’ standings, as best of the rest behind the top four teams, and his contribution key to helping Racing Bulls sit fifth in the constructors’ championship, it would have been nonsensical to have dropped him.
Racing Bulls team principal Alan Permane believed that the line-up of Lawson and Lindblad was the perfect one in terms of blending youth and experience.
“Both have demonstrated their ability and potential throughout the season, and we’ve seen the progress they’ve made, both individually and as a pairing,” explained Permane.

“I have no doubt that this is the best driver line-up for us, bringing a strong combination of experience and ambition. Together, we have a solid foundation to build on the progress made this year, continue pushing ourselves forward and take the next step towards achieving our ambitions in 2027."
Lawson has earned praise in the paddock this year for his standout performances for both Racing Bulls and during a stand-in run at Red Bull, when he filled in for the injured Isack Hadjar.
He thanked Racing Bulls for the belief in him.
“We've had a brilliant season together and the team has worked very hard to produce a fast car, which I've loved driving,” he said.
“It feels great to be part of a historic season for the team as we continue our fight for P5 in the constructors' championship.

"It's a testament to the hard work of everyone both at track, and back at the factory. I’m looking forward to carrying this momentum forward with Arvid through to 2027; we're building something super positive and I’m excited by what we can achieve together.”
The Racing Bulls statement that announced Lawson and Lindblad were staying for 2027 did not make any reference to plans for Tsolov, who is in the hunt to clinch the F2 crown this year.
The Bulgarian had a rookie FP1 run for Racing Bulls in Mexico, and will likely have a wider role with Red Bull in 2027. He has also been linked with a switch to Super Formula in Japan.
Racing Bulls: Liam Lawson/Arvid Lindblad
Aston Martin: Fernando Alonso/Lance Stroll

items.summaryEn: Racing Bulls has confirmed that Liam Lawson will remain with the team for the 2027 Formula 1 season, partnering Arvid Lindblad for a second year. There had been speculation about Lawson's future with the team, with F2 star Nikola Tsolov tipped as a possible replacement.

小红牛车队确认利亚姆·劳森将在2027年F1赛季继续留队，与阿尔维德·林德布拉德搭档第二年。
劳森和林德布拉德今年组成了强大的搭档，推动小红牛车队在制造商锦标赛中升至第五名，这将成为这支英意车队有史以来的最佳成绩。
但尽管贡献了89分，是新人林德布拉德的两倍，劳森的未来仍被蒙上阴影，因为小红牛在短期表现需求与为母队红牛车队培养年轻车手的明确目标之间进行权衡。
红牛拥有令人兴奋的保加利亚年轻新秀尼古拉·措洛夫，他是F2的领跑者，正在等待机会，红牛已给予他私人测试机会以及在墨西哥的一节新秀FP1练习赛。
但随着劳森近几周挺身而出，在持续压力下交出一些他最强劲的比赛，这位24岁的新西兰人表现太过出色，让车队无法忽视。消息人士在巴西大奖赛周末向Motorsport.com透露，在公司高层大力推动支持措洛夫的背景下，随着劳森在美洲三连赛中的表现，天平又摆回了有利于劳森的一边。
劳森现已签下一份新合同，将在2027年继续留在车队，而林德布拉德在经历了一个充满希望的新秀赛季后获得第二个赛季的机会。
车队领队艾伦·佩尔曼表示，他“毫不怀疑”车队下赛季将派出尽可能最强的车手阵容。
艾伦·佩尔曼，小红牛，利亚姆·劳森，小红牛
“我们很高兴能在2027年继续与利亚姆和阿尔维德合作，”佩尔曼在周四上午宣布。“两人在整个赛季中都展现了各自的能力和潜力，我们也看到了他们取得的进步，无论是个人的还是作为搭档的。我毫不怀疑这是我们最好的车手阵容，带来了经验与雄心的强有力结合。我们将携手在今年的进步基础上夯实基础，继续推动自己向前，迈出下一步，朝着在2027年实现我们目标的方向前进。”
劳森补充道：“我非常高兴明年能继续留在 Visa Cash App 小红牛 车队。我们一起度过了一个出色的赛季，车队非常努力地打造了一辆快车，我很喜欢驾驶它。能成为车队这个历史性赛季的一部分，感觉棒极了，我们正在继续为车队积分榜第五名而战。这证明了赛道现场和工厂里每个人付出的辛勤努力。”
“我期待与阿尔维德一起把这种势头延续到 2027 年；我们正在打造非常积极的东西，我对我们能共同取得的成就感到兴奋。”
林德布拉德表示，他的首个 F1 赛季感觉“非常特别”，他希望在 2027 年在此基础上继续发展。
这位英国车手说：“回顾我在一级方程式的第一个赛季，这是真正特别的一年，从第一次季前测试开始就充满了新的经历和收获。我迫不及待想开始明年的比赛，在新秀赛季学到的一切基础上继续前进。这将是令人兴奋的一年，我期待继续与利亚姆并肩驾驶。”
detailEn: Liam Lawson retained by Racing Bulls for 2027 alongside Arvid Lindblad
There had been speculation surrounding Lawson's future with the team, with F2 star Nikola Tsolov tipped as a replacement.
Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls, Liam Lawson, Racing Bulls
Racing Bulls has confirmed Liam Lawson will stay with the team for the 2027 Formula 1 season, partnering Arvid Lindblad for a second year.
Lawson and Lindblad formed a formidable duo this year as they propelled Racing Bulls to fifth in the constructors' championship, which is set to be the Anglo-Italian team's best-ever result.

But despite accounting for 89 points, twice the number rookie Lindblad managed, Lawson's future had been thrown into doubt as Racing Bulls weighed up its need for short-term performance with its explicit goal of training young drivers for its parent team Red Bull Racing.
Red Bull has the exciting young Bulgarian prospect Nikola Tsolov, a frontrunner in F2, waiting in the wings, having handed him private testing opportunities and a rookie FP1 session in Mexico.

But with Lawson rising to the occasion in recent weeks, delivering some of his strongest races under constant pressure, the 24-year-old New Zealander has been too good for the team to ignore. Sources indicated to Motorsport.com over the Brazilian Grand Prix weekend that amid a big push for the company's top leadership to back Tsolov, the pendulum swung back towards Lawson's favour with his performances over the Americas triple-header.
Lawson has now signed a fresh deal that will keep him at the team for 2027, with Lindblad afforded a second season after a promising rookie campaign.
Team boss Alan Permane said he had "no doubt" the team will field the strongest possible line-up next season.
Alan Permane, Racing Bulls, Liam Lawson, Racing Bulls

"We’re delighted to be continuing with Liam and Arvid for 2027," Permane announced on Thursday morning. "Both have demonstrated their ability and potential throughout the season, and we’ve seen the progress they’ve made, both individually and as a pairing. I have no doubt that this is the best driver line-up for us, bringing a strong combination of experience and ambition. Together, we have a solid foundation to build on the progress made this year, continue pushing ourselves forward and take the next step towards achieving our ambitions in 2027."

Lawson added: "I’m very happy to be continuing with Visa Cash App Racing Bulls next year. We’ve had a brilliant season together and the team has worked very hard to produce a fast car, which I’ve loved driving. It feels great to be part of a historic season for the team as we continue our fight for P5 in the Constructors' Championship. It's a testament to the hard work of everyone both at track, and back at the factory.
"I’m looking forward to carrying this momentum forward with Arvid through to 2027; we’re building something super positive and I’m excited by what we can achieve together.”
Lindblad said his maiden F1 campaign felt "truly special" as he aims to build on a solid foundation in 2027.

"Looking back on my first season in Formula 1, it's been a truly special year, full of new experiences and learnings since the very first pre-season test," the Briton said. "I can't wait to get started next year, building on everything I've learned during my rookie season. It's set to be an exciting year, and I look forward to continuing to drive alongside Liam."

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在银石推出了全额资助的GR63卡丁车学院。
乔治·拉塞尔推出GR63学院，旨在帮助25名年轻车手绕过卡丁车运动的财务障碍。
赛车文化不仅限于赛道。车手的生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计以及那些让赛车运动超越体育本身的故事。
赛车运动存在令人担忧的财务门槛，初级卡丁车赛季经常需要花费六位数以上的费用。梅赛德斯一级方程式车手乔治·拉塞尔正在采取直接行动来改变这一现状。
拉塞尔正式宣布了GR63学院的启动，这是一个与银石赛道和英国赛车驾驶俱乐部合作创立的草根卡丁车计划。该计划明确旨在绕过传统付费参与的青少年赛车模式，为有才华的孩子们提供一个合法、全额资助的晋升阶梯。
"卡丁车是我一切的开始，在我的职业生涯中扮演了至关重要的角色，" 拉塞尔在他的公告中写道。"我也知道有才华的年轻车手获得首次机会是多么困难，尤其是在预算有限的情况下。
"通过GR63学院，我想通过发现隐藏的才华并向他们提供他们实现全部潜力的支持和指导，来回报我的运动所给予我的，" 拉塞尔继续说道。
2027赛季的首个选拔过程完全基于实力，而非预算。该计划将在位于银石赛道卡丁车场的不同阶段进行操作：
第一阶段（2026年12月）：开放式的“到站即赛”资格赛将从12月6日持续到12月31日。
第二阶段（2027年1月）：从初始资格赛脱颖而出的80名最快车手将晋级到1月31日的对决。
第三阶段（锦标赛）：在银石赛道的前两轮比赛之后，拉塞尔将选出25名年轻车手加入2027年的GR63学院。这25名孩子将在2027年3月至11月期间参加一个八轮的卡丁车系列赛。
学院将为这25名选出的车手承担所有参赛费用，为他们提供一套完整的赛车装备，包括连体服、头盔、靴子和手套。锦标赛的每一轮比赛都将在一个不同的赛道配置上在银石赛道进行。
在整个八轮锦标赛中，车手们将在赛车技巧、原始圈速、体能和媒体技能方面接受评估。拉塞尔将积极参与作为导师，指导年轻才俊通过严格的培养过程。
该计划将于2027年12月结束，届时锦标赛的前五名完赛者将在银石赛道进行一场决赛。
GR63学院的总体获胜者将获得2028年日历年度全额资助的卡丁车赛季。
detailEn: George Russell launches fully-funded GR63 Karting Academy at Silverstone
George Russell launches the fully-funded GR63 Academy to help 25 young drivers bypass the financial barriers of karting
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Motorsport has an alarming financial barrier to entry, with seasons of junior karting frequently running deep into the six figures. Mercedes Formula 1 star George Russell is taking direct action to change that.

Russell officially announced the launch of the GR63 Academy, a grassroots karting initiative created in partnership with Silverstone and the British Racing Drivers' Club. The programme is explicitly designed to bypass the traditional pay-to-play model of junior motorsport and provide a legitimate, fully funded ladder for talented kids.

"Karting is where it all started for me and has played an essential role in my career," Russell wrote in his announcement. "I also know how difficult it is for talented young drivers to get their first opportunity, especially when budgets are limited."

"With the GR63 Academy, I want to give back to my sport what it has given me by spotting hidden talent and offering them the support and guidance they need to reach their full potential," Russell continued.
The selection process for the inaugural 2027 season is based purely on merit, not budget. The programme will operate in distinct stages based at the Silverstone karting circuit:
Stage 1 (December 2026): Open-access "arrive-and-drive" qualifying sessions will run from 6 December to 31 December.
Stage 2 (January 2027): The 80 fastest drivers from the initial qualifying stage will advance to a shootout on 31 January 2027.

Stage 3 (The Championship): Following the first two rounds at Silverstone, Russell will select 25 young drivers to join the GR63 Academy in 2027. These 25 kids will compete in an eight-round karting series running from March to November 2027.

The academy will cover all participation costs for the 25 selected drivers, providing them with a complete set of racing equipment, including overalls, a helmet, boots, and gloves. Each round of the championship will take place on a different circuit configuration at Silverstone.

Throughout the eight-round championship, drivers will be evaluated on racecraft, raw lap times, fitness, and media skills. Russell will actively participate as a mentor, guiding the young talent through the rigorous development process.
The programme concludes in December 2027, when the top five finishers from the championship will face off in a final race at Silverstone.
The overall winner of the GR63 Academy will be rewarded with a fully funded karting season for the 2028 calendar year.

detailEn: Mercedes Formula 1 driver George Russell has launched a new karting academy at Silverstone aimed at developing the next generation of motorsport talent, with 25 young drivers set to receive a fully funded championship opportunity in 2027.

The GR63 Karting Academy will be open to boys and girls aged eight and nine, with Russell hoping to provide a route into motorsport for talented youngsters who might otherwise be held back by the financial demands of the sport.
Based at Silverstone's karting circuit, the initiative will run across four stages, beginning with open-access qualifying sessions in December 2026.
The first stage will see eligible drivers compete in arrive-and-drive sessions between December 6 and 31, with the 80 fastest progressing to a shootout on January 31, 2027.

From there, 25 drivers will be selected for the GR63 Championship, an eight-round series running from March to November 2027. Each round will take place on a different circuit configuration at Silverstone, with all participation costs covered by the academy.
The 25 selected drivers will also receive a full set of academy equipment, including racing overalls, a helmet, gloves and boots.

The programme will culminate in December 2027, when the championship's top five finishers compete in a final race at Silverstone. Drivers will be evaluated on their talent, lap times, fitness, racecraft and media skills, with the overall winner receiving a fully-funded karting season in 2028.
Russell will help mentor and guide participants throughout the programme.
"Karting is where it all started for me, and it taught me everything I've relied on throughout my career," said Russell.
"I know how hard it is for talented young drivers to get that first opportunity, especially when budgets are tight.
"With the GR63 Karting Academy, I want to give something back by finding those hidden talents and giving them the support and platform they need to reach their potential."

The financial accessibility of the programme is a central part of its appeal. While the initial qualifying sessions will cost £25 and entry to the January shootout will cost £75, everything from the championship stage onwards will be fully funded.
The initiative is being supported by Silverstone and the British Racing Drivers' Club (BRDC), with BRDC president David Coulthard welcoming the opportunity to invest in Britain's motorsport future.
"The GR63 Academy captures that ethos perfectly, and we are delighted to work with George to support the next generation of drivers here at Silverstone," said Coulthard.
The initial arrive-and-drive qualifying sessions will take place at Silverstone Kart Track between December 6 and 31, 2026, at a cost of £25.
All applicants must be citizens of a Commonwealth country.
Further information and bookings are available through Silverstone's GR63 Academy website.

detailZh: 维斯塔潘谈法拉利冲突：“我绝不会签下两位一号车手”
这位荷兰车手表示，如果自己是车队领队，绝不会选择两位主导车手。维斯塔潘认为一辆好车就是全部所需，在这种情况下一位“合格的二号车手”效果更好。
尽管法拉利一级方程式车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔周四晚在圣保罗与刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔交谈以缓和气氛，但关于墨西哥法拉利冲突的言论和报道已经铺天盖地。
当马克斯·维斯塔潘在巴西被问及看法时，这位红牛车手表示，他主要将这一事件视为法拉利车手阵容的结果。这位荷兰人对Viaplay说，一艘船上两位船长，这类事情必然发生。
维斯塔潘说：“如果你只有一个明确的一号车手和一个明确的二号车手，他们就会以第一和第二的位置通过那个弯道，也会以第一和第二的名次完赛。或者也许是第一和第三，但那也没问题。作为一支车队，你仍然在获得不错的积分。”
勒克莱尔认为，墨西哥站的事故很大程度上与罗德里格斯兄弟赛道的布局有关，但维斯塔潘主要将其视为对自己长期以来所持理念的印证——包括从车队领队的角度来思考时也是如此。
“我以前就说过，”他继续说道，“人们经常不同意我的看法，但如果我是车队领队——如果我拥有自己的车队——我绝不会签下两位一号车手，因为那样就会出现这种情况。
“那样的话这很正常。一个人不会给另一个人让路，因为他们当然都认为自己能赢，我也是这样。”
“所以，如果我是车队领队，我绝不会选择两位头号车手。有些人完全不同意这一点，但那也没关系。”
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
当被问及他在F1中做出自己的职业选择时——例如，在选择车队或签署新合同时——是否会特别考虑到这一点时，这位四届世界冠军继续说道：“有时候你可能也没有选择，但[拥有两位领头车手]确实让一切变得更加复杂。”
维斯塔潘相信，一辆有竞争力的赛车就是他完成任务所需要的一切。这位荷兰人最近再次明确了这一点，他提到了2023年F1赛季，在那个赛季中，仅他自己的积分就足以赢得车队冠军。
“如果你有一辆好车，那么你也不一定需要两个一号车手。只需要一个合格的二号车手，”他补充道。“纵观一级方程式赛车的历史，也很清楚这样的事情完全可以运转良好，甚至能持续多年。”
在最后这几句话中，维斯塔潘不仅指自己的职业生涯，也指汉密尔顿——在梅赛德斯的大部分夺冠年份里，汉密尔顿几乎没遇到来自博塔斯的抵抗；还指迈克尔·舒马赫——在法拉利时，他身边是巴里切罗。
detailEn: Max Verstappen on Ferrari clashes: "I would never sign two number-one drivers"
The Dutchman says he would never opt for two lead drivers if he were a team principal. Verstappen believes a good car is all that is needed and a "decent number two" works better in that situation

Although Ferrari Formula 1 team principal Frederic Vasseur spoke to Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc on Thursday evening in Sao Paulo to clear the air, an extraordinary amount had already been said and written about the Ferrari clash in Mexico.

When Max Verstappen was asked for his opinion in Brazil, the Red Bull driver indicated that he primarily sees the incident as a consequence of Ferrari’s driver line-up. With two captains on one ship, such things are bound to happen, the Dutchman told Viaplay.

"If you simply had one clear number one and one clear number two, they would have gone through that corner in first and second, and they would have finished first and second as well. Or maybe first and third, but that's fine too. As a team, you're still scoring good points," Verstappen said.

According to Leclerc, the incident in Mexico was largely related to the layout of Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, but Verstappen sees it primarily as confirmation of a philosophy he has held for some time – including when thinking from a team principal's perspective.
"I've said it before," he continued. "People very often disagree with me, but if I were a team principal – if I had my own team – I would never sign two number-one drivers, because then you get this.
"Then this is normal. One isn't going to give way to the other, because of course they both think they can win, and that's how I am too.
"So if I were a team principal, I would never go for two number-one drivers. Some people completely disagree with that, but that's fine as well."
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

When asked whether he specifically takes this into account when making his own career choices in F1 – for example, when choosing a team or signing a new contract – the four-time world champion continued: "Sometimes you might not have a choice in that either, but [having two lead drivers] does make everything more complicated."

Verstappen believes that a competitive car is all he needs to get the job done. The Dutchman recently made that clear once again by referring to the 2023 F1 season, in which his own points tally alone would have been enough to win the constructors' championship.

"If you have a good car, then you don't necessarily need that either, two number-one drivers. Just a decent number two," he added. "Throughout Formula 1 history, it's also always been clear that something like that works perfectly well, even for years."

With those final words, Verstappen was not just referring to his own career, but also to Hamilton, who faced little resistance from Valtteri Bottas during most of his title-winning years at Mercedes, and Michael Schumacher with Rubens Barrichello alongside him at Ferrari.

detailZh: 最终版的奔驰SLR麦拉伦斯特林·莫斯将拍卖超过600万美元
最后一辆生产的奔驰SLR麦拉伦斯特林·莫斯即将由RM Sotheby's进行拍卖
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
最后一辆离开工厂的奔驰SLR麦拉伦斯特林·莫斯重返市场，RM Sotheby's将其无顶跑车估值超过600万美元（450万英镑）。
这辆底盘编号为75的赛车正在拍卖行的在线密封12月拍卖中，拍卖从11月25日开始，至12月2日结束。
梅赛德斯-奔驰和迈凯轮从2009年6月到2009年12月底共制造了75辆斯特林·莫斯版SLR，作为SLR的最终版本。它没有车顶、挡风玻璃或侧窗，其650马力的涡轮增压V8发动机使其最高时速达到350公里/小时。当时它的价格为75万欧元，仅向现有的SLR车主提供。
根据RM Sotheby's的说法，这辆车是科威特王室订购的新车，于2009年12月完成，并于2010年3月在瑞士首次注册。没有其他梅赛德斯-奔驰SLR 迈凯伦斯特林·莫斯车型采用火蛋白红漆。它还配有红色皮革内饰和黄色缝线、金色刹车卡钳和立体声音响，据信只有另一辆同型号的车辆从新时就拥有这些配置。
它最后一次易手是在2024年10月6日于比利时Knokke-Heist的Bonhams Zoute拍卖会上，当时以无底价322万欧元成交。
新车主将其运往美国，在加利福尼亚的G&K Automotive公司根据展示或展示规则将其变为合法上路车辆，该规则允许少量具有历史意义的汽车进口。
"该车辆于2009年12月由工厂完成，按照欧洲标准制造，并全新交付至瑞士，首次注册于2010年3月16日，在沃州注册。" 列表中总结道。"自那时以来，新车仅行驶了32.9英里。"
RM Sotheby's 拍卖会上还有其他有趣的汽车，包括2009年法拉利F430 Spider、2014年奔驰SLS AMG Black Series和2018年保时捷911 Turbo Classic Series "Project Gold"。
detailEn: Final Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren Stirling Moss heads to auction for over $6million
The final Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren Stirling Moss ever built is heading to auction with RM Sotheby's
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
The final Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren Stirling Moss to leave the factory is back on the market, with RM Sotheby's valuing the roofless speedster at more than $6million (£4.5million).
The car, chassis number 75, is in the auction house's online Sealed December sale, with bidding open from 25 November until 2 December.

Mercedes and McLaren built 75 Stirling Moss models from June 2009 until the end of December 2009 as the final version of the SLR. It has no roof, windscreen or side windows, and its 650-horsepower supercharged V8 gives a top speed of 350km/h. It was priced at €750,000 at the time and was only offered to existing SLR owners.

According to RM Sotheby's, this car was ordered new by Kuwait's royal family, finished in December 2009 and first registered in Switzerland in March 2010. No other Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren Stirling Moss features Fire Opal Red paint. It also has a red leather interior with yellow stitching, gold brake callipers and a stereo, which only one other example of the model is believed to have had from new.
It last changed hands at Bonhams' Zoute sale in Knokke-Heist, Belgium, on 6 October 2024, when it sold for €3.22million without reserve.

The new owner shipped it to the United States, where it has just been made road-legal by G&K Automotive in California under the Show or Display rule, which lets small numbers of historically significant cars be imported.

"Completed by the factory in December of 2009, the car was built to European specifications and delivered new to Switzerland, where it was first registered on 16 March 2010 in the canton of Vaud," the listing concluded. "Since then, it has been driven just 32.9 miles from new."
Other interesting cars up for auction with RM Sotheby's include a 2009 Ferrari F430 Spider, a 2014 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG Black Series and a 2018 Porsche 911 Turbo Classic Series "Project Gold".

detailZh: 拉塞尔称沃尔夫用人不疑助梅赛德斯重夺F1车队总冠军：“没有人被聘用或解雇”
这位梅赛德斯车手表示，赢得车队总冠军的这批人，正是经历过车队四年低谷期的那批人
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
乔治·拉塞尔表示，托托·沃尔夫在地面效应时代的艰难岁月里拒绝改变梅赛德斯，这是车队重返一级方程式巅峰的重要原因。
这支位于布拉克利的车队在周日的圣保罗大奖赛上锁定了第九个车队总冠军，这是自2021年结束八连冠以来首次夺冠。从2022年到2025年，他们经历了四个赛季的鲜有成功，一直在努力克服地面效应赛车的挑战。
拉塞尔在接受媒体采访时表示，尽管性能突然下滑，车队始终信任自己的人员。
“这些年我们经历了很多。那是一段极其艰难的时期，”他说。“但我认为托托领导风格中我很钦佩的一点是，我们今天拥有的人和辉煌岁月里的人是同一批人，也是经历过2022到2025年困难时期的同一批人。没有人被聘用或解雇。
“感谢团队中的每一个人，但尤其要大大感谢托托，感谢他的忠诚和对大家的信任，即使在艰难时期也是如此。”
在英特拉格斯赛后，沃尔夫本人被问及车队的稳定性，这位奥地利负责人也指出了员工流动率低的问题。
他说，稳定性“当然是一个因素”，“但我们最近也有许多人加入，我想我选择用的词是安全感。你知道，我们不是一个随意雇人又随意解雇的组织。”
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
我们提供一种文化和环境，让你能够茁壮成长，允许你犯错，允许你直言不讳。从长远来看，我相信如果你想取得成功，不是几年，而是几十年，这就是你需要灌输给车队的东西。
他也承认，那些年过起来比成绩所显示的更艰难。看成绩，你会看到车队在其中两个赛季获得第二名，但这对车队来说是一段充满挑战的时期。
沃尔夫说：“单看数字，情况根本没有那么糟，但感觉并不好。我认为，车队的韧性，那些在艰难时期团结在一起的人，是一个因素。”
拉塞尔于2022年加入车队，经历了这一切。他的2026赛季非常艰难，因为他看着队友基米·安东内利赢得冠军。他现在在积分榜上排名第三，落后马克斯·维斯塔潘17分，还剩三场比赛。
沃尔夫在周日表示，车队总冠军的荣誉同样属于拉塞尔，和其他人一样：“我们欠他一份情。”
detailEn: George Russell credits Toto Wolff's loyalty for Mercedes' F1 title return: "Nobody was hired or fired"
The Mercedes driver says the people who won the constructors' title are the same ones who went through the team's four lean years
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
George Russell says Toto Wolff's refusal to change Mercedes during the difficult years of the ground effect era is a big reason the team is back on top of Formula 1.

The Brackley outfit sealed its ninth constructors' title at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix on Sunday, its first since the end of its run of eight in a row in 2021. From 2022 to 2025, it went four seasons with little success as it struggled to overcome the challenges of the ground effect cars.
Speaking to media, Russell said the team had remained trusting in its people despite teh sudden drop in performance.

"We have been through a lot over those years. It's been extremely tough times," he said. "But I think something I admire a lot about Toto's leadership is that the people we have today are the same people who were there during the glory years, and they're the same people who went through the difficulties during 2022 to 2025. Nobody was hired or fired.
"Credit to everybody in the team, but huge credit to Toto for that loyalty and belief in the people, even when times were tough."
Wolff himself was asked about stability of the team after the race at Interlagos, with the Austrian chief also pointing to the lack of staff turnover.

Stability was "certainly a factor", he said, "but we have also many people that have joined us recently, and I think what I would like to choose as a word is safety. You know, we are not a hire and fire organisation.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes

"We provide a culture and an environment where you can thrive, where you're allowed to make mistakes, where you can speak up. And over the long term, I believe if you want to be successful, not over a period of a few years, but over many, many decades, this is what you need to be able to kind of ingrain in the team."

He also admitted those years had been harder to live through than the results suggest. Look at the results and you'll see the team finishing second in two of those seasons, but it was a challenging time for the squad.

"It wasn't that bad at all when you look at the sheer numbers, but it felt not good," Wolff said. "And the resilience of the team, the people that held together in those tough times, is a factor, I think."

Russell, who joined the team in 2022, has been through all of it, His 2026 campaign has been very difficult as he watched team-mate Kimi Antonelli win the championship. He is now third in the championship, 17 points behind Max Verstappen with three races left.
Wolff said on Sunday that the constructors' title belonged to Russell as much as anyone: "we owe it to him".

detailZh: 布鲁诺·塞纳透露计划让基米·安东内利驾驶塞纳的F1赛车
布鲁诺·塞纳希望明年给2026年世界冠军基米·安东内利一个机会，驾驶塞纳的一辆历史性F1赛车

前F1车手布鲁诺·塞纳表示，他在2026年世界冠军访问巴西家族庄园后，希望给基米·安东内利一个机会，驾驶塞纳的一辆赛车
安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛赢得他首个F1冠军后的几天来到了这座庄园，成为该系列赛历史上最年轻的冠军车手。
在接受F1的《超越网格》播客采访时，布鲁诺表示，这位梅赛德斯车手几乎不想离开他叔叔在1986年驾驶过的Lotus 98T赛车。
“看到他真的很开心，”他说。‘我们有Lotus，那辆86年的赛车。我们让他跳进车里，他都不想离开。你有一个涡轮增压旋钮，他在探索一切——有一个可以更换的防滚杆，还有一个变速杆。’
安东内利对Lotus 98T的热爱让布鲁诺有了让这位意大利车手明年驾驶这辆车的想法。
“这真是有趣的事情——我正在谈论明年，当莲花或迈凯轮想要做些什么时，我们可以尝试为他安排驾驶这些车中的一辆，因为他真的很适合这款车，”他继续说道。
“你知道，他的身高非常适合。他的爸爸说，‘我不确定你能不能开手动挡的车’，而基米说，‘当然可以！’
除了坐在莲花98T赛车中，安东内利还在阿伊尔顿在庄园设计的卡丁车赛道上驾驶了一段时间，布鲁诺亲眼见证了这位20岁年轻人能做什么。
“最后，我们在阿伊尔顿设计的卡丁车赛道上驾驶了，”他补充道。 “这对我来说是个很有趣的事情，基米太棒了。他速度很快，非常稳定。我们玩得很开心。我得说我比较慢，因为我比他重10公斤，但老实说，我觉得还有其他原因！他太厉害了。”
“赛道非常脏，石头非常多。基米能够创造一个沟槽，并且他能够一直保持在那个沟槽里。这真的很令人印象深刻。他甚至不能偏离10厘米，因为那样你甚至无法跑宽——你会跑到草地上打转，因为那里太脏了。这是一次非常酷的经历，也展示了为什么他是世界冠军。”

Former Formula 1 driver Bruno Senna says he wants to give Kimi Antonelli the chance to drive one of Ayrton Senna's cars next year, after the 2026 world champion visited the family's estate in Brazil.
Antonelli arrived at the estate days after clinching his maiden F1 championship at the Mexican Grand Prix, becoming the youngest driver in the history of the series to win the title.
Speaking on F1's Beyond The Grid podcast, Bruno said the Mercedes driver barely wanted to get out of the Lotus 98T that his uncle raced in 1986.

"It was really, really fun to see him," he said. "We have the Lotus, the ‘86 car. We had him jump inside the car, and he didn't want to leave the car. You had the turbo boost knob, and he's exploring everything – having an anti-roll bar thing that you can change, and there's a gearstick."
Antonelli's love of the Lotus 98T gave Bruno the idea of having the Italian drive the car next year.

"This is something that was quite funny – I was talking [about] next year when Lotus or McLaren want to do something, we can try to organise for [him] to drive one of these cars because he fits really well in the car," he continued.
"You know, his height is perfect for it. His dad was like, ‘I'm not sure if you can drive the manual car’, and Kimi was like, ‘sure I can!’"
In addition to sitting in the Lotus 98T, Antonelli also had some time on the go-kart track that Ayrton designed on the estate, where Bruno saw first-hand what the 20-year-old can do.

"Finally, we drove on the go-kart track that Ayrton designed," he added. "It was a really fun thing when I was a kid, and Kimi was incredible. He was so fast, so consistent. We had a fun time. I would say that I was slower because I'm 10kg heavier, but I think there's a bit more than that in it, to be honest! He was amazing.

"The track was very dirty, very full of stone. Kimi was able to create a groove, and he was able to stay within that groove so consistently. It was really impressive. He couldn't move 10cm off because then you don't even run wide – you go onto the grass and spin out because it was so dirty. It was a really cool experience and showed why he's a world champion."
